text: Completed the portable EyeLink conformance court. Added typed non-vacuous manifests; operand-, field-, presence-, and named-tolerance-aware comparisons; typed unsupported metamorphic outcomes; and a deterministic packaged summary that distinguishes available comparisons from ASC coverage and licensed EDF certification. Six synthetic corpus families emit pinned semantic digests. Metamorphic tests cover LF/CRLF, structural whitespace, arbitrary byte chunking, samples/events subsets, frame-matched GAZE translation, and block concatenation. The pinned CRAN eyelinker 0.2.2 oracle now passes 57 exact common sample/native-event/message fields through the typed comparator. JVM: full io suite 185/185; Scala.js: full io suite 162/162; packageBin and checkBoundaries pass; JAR contains portable-conformance.tsv. Mutation proof: exact comparator mutant failed JVM and JS; semantic-projection mutant failed newline/whitespace/pinned-summary tests on JVM and JS. Licensed EDF evidence remains explicitly missing and is not certified.
